description: Log a file-modifying response with structured taxonomy and file paths. Call this AFTER every response where you created, edited, or deleted files. One call per response, not per file. Skip only for trivial changes (whitespace-only, single comment). Files ≤10: list full paths. Files >10: group by directory + list key files only. Pass either `workspace_id` (UUID; taken from your UserPromptSubmit hook session metadata) OR `cwd` (absolute working directory — the server resolves it to the workspace) — one is enough, not both. `task_summary` should be ONE concise sentence, ideally ≤300 characters. This call is NEVER rejected for length: anything past ~500 chars is stored auto-shortened, you get a non-blocking warning, not an error — so do not retry or rewrite to satisfy a limit. Default response is compact (`{ id, created_at, human_message }`); pass `verbose: true` to get the full activity row back.

action.description: What was done: create, update, fix, refactor, delete, style

applied_memory_ids.description: Optional. Memory ids you actually read and applied this turn. Pathrule uses this as a direct positive signal for the memory affinity model (M42) — only list memories whose content you genuinely consulted, not every id you saw in get_context. Requires session_id and a recent context_injection in the same session within the last 30 minutes; otherwise silently dropped.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory — server resolves to workspace_id via user_workspace_paths. Use this when workspace_id is unknown (e.g. first call of a fresh session, hook metadata missing).

domain.description: What area: ui, backend, database, infra, config, test, docs

files_touched.description: Files involved (optional). ≤10: full paths per area. >10: directory summaries.

node_path.description: Workspace-relative path, e.g. '/packages/app'. Targets the most specific node the activity belongs to.

scope.description: What kind of thing: component, page, hook, store, api, migration, service, model, util, project

session_id.description: Hook session_id from UserPromptSubmit metadata. When provided, the server drains the in-process PostToolUse buffer for this session and attaches tool_call_count / tool_failure_count / tool_failure_codes to this activity row.

subjects.description: Free-form keywords, lowercase. E.g. ['sidebar', 'resize-handle']. Only the first 5 are stored; extras are dropped, never rejected.

task_summary.description: One concise sentence describing the completed work. Ideal: ≤300 characters. NEVER rejected for length: anything past ~500 chars is stored auto-shortened with a non-blocking warning, so do not retry or rewrite to fit a limit. Keep it tight: what changed + why, no file paths (those go in `files_touched`) and no bullet lists. If the work is complex, compress to the essential decision: extra detail belongs in memories, not activity logs.

verbose.description: Set to true to receive the full activity row in the response. Default false (compact response).

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID. If omitted, pass `cwd` instead and the server will resolve it. The hook supervisor exposes this UUID in its UserPromptSubmit session metadata so you rarely need to fetch it.

name: pathrule_log_activity
title: Log Activity
